skill.summary: Multi-account patterns, networking, and well-architected trade-offs. Use when designing cloud systems.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the cloud-arch skill, providing structured guidance for designing cloud architecture.
- Introduces a four-stage workflow: clarify context/goals, design/plan, implement/validate, and operate/iterate.
- Includes a checklist to ensure goals, risks, and operational needs are addressed.
- Offers procedural, actionable advice focused on multi-account patterns, networking, and well-architected trade-offs.
- Adapts to user preference for workflow depth and style.
